items.reason: Direct parentage question; the opening identifies Abimelek as the son of Jerub-Baal.
The action question is clear, and the passage explicitly says Uzziah rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah.
“Yahweh” is not used or identified in the supplied passage, which says “the Lord.” This introduces an unnecessary naming inference, although Micah’s reason is explicitly supported.
“哪一天”直接询问约定的时间；引文明确说“明天我们就吃我的儿子”，只有D符合。

Clear giver–recipient question; the passage explicitly identifies the spears and shields given to the commanders.

“为什么一直讲到午夜”清楚询问原因；经文用“由于保罗第二天准备离开”明确支持A。
The question directly asks what Uzziah built at the gates; the passage explicitly answers “towers.”
